reviews.evidence: The adelic Schwartz space is the restricted tensor product over a number field; number field, finite-dimensional vector space, Schwartz space, and local/restricted factors are direct inputs, so number field and Schwartz space were added.
The space is defined by local compact abelian group structure, compact generated subgroups, and Schwartz functions; the listed prerequisites match those construction choices.
The definition splits archimedean and nonarchimedean cases for a local field and uses Schwartz/compactness/LCA spaces; local-field was added as the missing ambient input.
Smoothness means every vector has an open stabilizer in a locally profinite group; local profiniteness and stabilizers are exactly the direct concepts.
A spherical function is defined from a Gelfand pair and Haar convolution with a compact subgroup; local compactness, convolution, Gelfand pair, and Haar measure are direct.
The Satake algebra uses an unramified reductive p-adic group, hyperspecial compact subgroup, normalized Haar measure, and convolution; all are direct.
The transform integrates a K-bi-invariant function against spherical functions on a real semisimple Lie group; Lie group, maximal compact, Haar, and spherical function are direct.
Supercuspidality is defined by vanishing Jacquet modules for proper parabolics in the admissible p-adic representation setting; each listed representation-theoretic structure is direct.
The definition combines a locally compact action, Hilbert representation, and projection-valued measure with covariance; listed prerequisites cover each defining object.
The tempered dual is the subspace of the unitary dual consisting of representations weakly contained in the regular representation; the topology subspace and all representation notions are direct.
The p-adic tempered condition uses admissibility, unitary central character, and the reductive/local-field setting; center and character data are direct.
Temperedness is weak containment in the regular representation for a strongly continuous unitary representation; the Hilbert and reduced C-star context are direct.

The construction takes two strongly continuous unitary representations on Hilbert spaces and acts on their completed tensor product; all listed representation, Hilbert, inner-product, and unitary concepts are direct.
The test-function space differs between Lie and totally disconnected local groups; local field, Lie group, and local profinite structure are defining case data.
Unimodularity is the condition that the modular function is one, equivalently left Haar is right invariant; modular function, Haar, and right translation are direct.
A unitary character is a continuous homomorphism into the circle and equivalently a one-dimensional unitary representation; group homomorphism and representation are direct.
The unitary dual consists of unitary-equivalence classes of irreducible strongly continuous unitary representations on Hilbert spaces; every listed prerequisite enters the definition.
The reciprocity isomorphism compares intertwiners with a compact-group induced representation; strong unitary representations, induction, Haar averaging, and intertwining maps are direct.
Induction uses a locally compact group, closed subgroup, quasi-invariant measure on G/H, Hilbert bundle, and translations; all listed prerequisites are used in the construction.
An unramified representation is defined by a hyperspecial-fixed vector in an irreducible admissible representation of an unramified reductive p-adic group; listed inputs are direct.
Weak containment is defined by approximating matrix coefficients of unitary representations uniformly on compact sets; representation, Hilbert, compact-set, and absolute-value notions are direct.
The formula decomposes Haar integration over G into integration over G/H and H using modular factors; locally compact homogeneous spaces, Haar measures, and modular functions are direct.

A Whittaker model is a space of functions transforming by a nondegenerate unitary character of the unipotent radical; quasi-split group, local field, Borel/unipotent data, character, and linear maps are direct.
The Wiener transform is a unitary extension defined on a Gaussian Hilbert space and Fock-polynomial subspace; Gaussian measure, Fock space, and unitary operator are direct.
The X-ray transform integrates an integrable function along affine lines; Lebesgue integrability is the only nonlocal prerequisite and matches the core.
Young's inequality combines unimodularity, Haar convolution, bilinear structure, Hölder, and Tonelli to bound Lp convolution; each is used in the statement/proof.
